recognition_note: Antigen A is the human IL6ST/gp130 ectodomain (100% sequence identity to UniProt P40189 in the supplied search results). Every advocacy identified the Fab as exact murine HyHEL-63, but I independently checked that assertion on 2026-10-29 against RCSB 1DQQ (released 2000-01-19) and found it false: a global alignment gives supplied heavy B only 59.4% identity (130/219) to 1DQQ heavy B and H3 ARNYYEDYFDY rather than 1DQQ H3 ASWGGDV; supplied light C is 90.7% identical (194/214). I therefore recognize gp130 but not the antibody clone, and I do not transfer HyHEL-63's lysozyme epitope or energetic preferences to this binder.
what_separated_them: No candidate has a Tier A line about this binder. The unanimous HyHEL-63 identification was false and was removed rather than allowed to concentrate the distribution. What remains is a broad prior over surfaces, modestly separated by one uniform calculation and by other-binder precedent: C2's compact planar aromatic D2 face led; C1 paid for an under-supported D3 rim; C4/C3/C7 divided the probability of one overlapping D1 site-III surface; C5 stayed live because excellent accessibility can matter even without a named function or mapped antibody; C6 paid for glycan proximity and a speculative consequence. Functional-site detail was not allowed to substitute for localization.
